description.value: Yagoto Sushi is a Japanese family-owned restaurant in Kitsilano, helmed by Chef Yama-san whose sushi training began in Osaka in 1980 before he brought the craft to Vancouver. The menu spans nigiri, sashimi, donburi, udon, and a wide range of specialty rolls, making it a substantial sit-down meal option. It sits on the West Broadway cycling corridor, a natural waypoint for riders exploring Kitsilano.
